sections.label: Mind
sections.text:
Suicidal ; depressed ; laughing and weeping
moods alternate.

sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Pressure on top, in right temple, associated
with backache.

sections.label: Male
sections.text:
Great lassitude following coitus. Sexual
power increased.

sections.label: Female
sections.text:
Intermittent neuralgia of left ovary. Acrid,
profuse leucorrhoea, with retarded menses.

sections.label: Respiratory
sections.text:
Dry cough, with stitches in chest.
Dyspnoea.

sections.label: Extremities
sections.text:
Unusual tired feeling. Chorea, espt'^
daily during sleep. Fidgety legs. [Tarant.] Lame-
ness in arms and spasmodic twitching.

sections.label: Relationship
sections.text:
Compare : Agar. ; Stram. ; Tarant. ;
Cicuta; JEthusa.
